DeterminationBasis: T16-013 directly requires a conformance claim to identify the exact profile and prevents conformance from being silently inherited, substituted or transferred across another profile; its failure oracle expressly rejects transfer to another profile without a separately established conformance basis. T16-011 independently reinforces that a claimed property cannot silently transfer to another profile or subject without a separately established claim. No additional abstract test definition is required.

Existing T05 controls govern provenance, admissibility, evidence identity, epistemic class and evidentiary sufficiency, but no existing T05 test requires test evidence to preserve the complete four-part tuple of test input, expected result, observed result and determination. TEST-002 therefore requires a distinct abstract test definition.
